reports.title: BAUSCH HEALTH ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS, RAISES GUIDANCE

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: The Company updated its Consolidated full year Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA1 guidance for 2026.

Bausch Health (excluding Bausch + Lomb) is raising its full year Revenue, Adjusted EBITDA1, and Adjusted Cash Flows from Operations1 guidance, which includes the currently estimated impact of applicable tariffs for the calendar year as of the date of this release.

BHC | BHC (excl. B+L) | B+L
Revenues (in billions) | $10.975 - $11.175 | $5.525 - $5.625 | $5.450 - $5.550
Revenue growth vs. Prior Year | 7% - 9%
Adjusted EBITDA1 (in billions) | $4.315 - $4.415 | $3.225 - $3.275 | $1.090 - $1.140
Adj. EBITDA1 growth vs. Prior Year | 12% - 14%
Adjusted Cash Flows from Operations1 (in billions) | $1.600 - $1.675
